topics.name: Mood Journal Analyzer
topics.concept: Journals become data when entries are tagged with mood ratings, energy levels, and mentioned activities. Aggregating tags over weeks reveals patterns, such as low moods clustering on certain weekdays. The tool is a self-reflection aid for wellness tracking, with clear text that it does not diagnose anything. Includes prominent disclaimer text that the tool is for wellness self-tracking and screening only, never a diagnosis, and encourages consulting a professional.
topics.data_idea: Generates synthetic journal entries with known mood patterns for analysis drills.
topics.real_world_use: Journal analytics help people notice patterns in their own wellbeing.

topics.name: PHQ-9-Style Self-Assessment Scorer
topics.concept: Depression screening questionnaires ask how often symptoms occurred over two weeks, scoring each answer from zero to three and summing to a total. Score bands suggest minimal through severe symptom levels, but only a clinician can diagnose. This educational tool computes scores from synthetic responses and always displays screening-only disclaimer text. Includes prominent disclaimer text that the tool is for wellness self-tracking and screening only, never a diagnosis, and encourages consulting a professional.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes questionnaire responses with known score totals for scorer drills.
topics.real_world_use: Screening questionnaires are the standard first step in depression screening workflows.

topics.name: GAD-7-Style Self-Assessment Scorer
topics.concept: Anxiety screening questionnaires follow the same structure as depression screens: frequency-rated items summed into a total with severity bands. The tool is strictly educational, showing how scoring works on synthetic data while making clear that results are not a diagnosis. Disclaimer text accompanies every result screen. Includes prominent disclaimer text that the tool is for wellness self-tracking and screening only, never a diagnosis, and encourages consulting a professional.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes questionnaire responses with known score totals for scorer drills.
topics.real_world_use: Anxiety screens are routine in primary-care wellness checkups.
